extraction.name: LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data
extraction.description: A multimodal dataset featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, designed for learning from uncertain data. It extends CIFAR-10/100 with audio samples from three audio corpora and text data generated using Gemma-7B LLM. Includes a Python package for controlled injection of uncertainty.
extraction.creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, Sébastien Fournier
extraction.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Fournier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images from CIFAR-10/100; audio from Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, Mozilla Common Voice, and voluntary contributions; text generated using Gemma-7B Instruct LLM with 13 prompts.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CIFAR-10/100 images; Spoken Wikipedia, LibriSpeech, Mozilla Common Voice audio; Gemma-7B Instruct generated text.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio: extracted segments using forced alignments, validated with Whisper Large V3 and manual validation. Text: generated with Gemma-7B, validated by masking labels and re-classifying. Images: selected from CIFAR-10/100 and EDM-generated images. Bias reduction for 'man', 'woman', 'boy', 'girl' classes by reconstructing prompts.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Manual validation of audio samples: 2 annotations per sample from 17 annotators using Label Studio. Text validation: automatic classification by Gemma-7B after masking labels.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: 71.61% annotation agreement for audio; conflicting annotations rejected.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Colleagues (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI Whisper Large V3, Gemma-7B Instruct
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Gender bias in text for classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', 'girl'.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Gender bias in text for classes 'man', 'woman', 'boy', 'girl'; potential racial, religious, cultural biases detected by Gemma model.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset may contain factual inaccuracies or biases from LLM generation; not to be used as a source of knowledge. Audio may have misaligned segments or strong accents.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking multimodal learning algorithms on uncertain data, uncertainty quantification, OOD detection.
